hypothesis: Cross-sectional contracts with persistently positive actual taker-buy minus taker-sell pressure continue to outperform contracts with persistently negative pressure over the next moderately spaced holding interval.
falsifier: Falsify if exact sign inversion is not materially worse, pressure-tail returns fail to order monotonically, or the base effect does not survive the fixed cost, turnover, fold, and breadth gates.
formation_horizon: 30 completed UTC days, capped at 90 eight-hour bars and requiring at least 72 valid aggressor-imbalance observations; persistence uses the latest 63 valid bars.
rebalance_horizon: First call in each fixed 96-hour UTC timestamp bucket, with unchanged buckets returning no rebalance request.
control_profile: Completed bars only; actual paired total and taker-buy volume only; long and short pressure thresholds; equal 0.50 gross side budgets; deterministic symbol tie-breaks; organizer-enforced volatility, drawdown, and turnover controls.

material_parameters.rebalance_alignment: integer UTC timestamp nanoseconds divided by the 96-hour interval
material_parameters.invalid_aggressor_rows: exclude nonfinite rows, nonpositive totals, negative taker buys, and taker buys above paired totals
material_parameters.portfolio_requirement: at least one qualifying positive-pressure contract and one qualifying negative-pressure contract
